Question ID: ANP_U01_L01_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.SCI.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Anatomy and Physiology as a Science
Stimulus: Inquiry/evidence scenario

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, separate anatomy as structure from physiology as function. Then use the required stimulus (Inquiry/evidence scenario) to connect the visible evidence to scientific evidence in anatomy and physiology. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.SCI.01 and avoids the common mistake: thinking anatomy is only memorizing body parts.

answer.text: thinking anatomy is only memorizing body parts This misses the evidence required for Anatomy and Physiology as a Science.
